definitions: To spread something out, usually flat.
To arrange something according to a plan.
To design or plan something in detail.
To prepare a dead body for burial or viewing.
To spend money, often a significant amount.
examples: She laid out the picnic blanket on the grass.
The architect laid out the plans for the new building.
The garden was beautifully laid out with various plants.
The funeral director laid out the deceased.
He laid out a lot of money for the new car.
One punch laid him out cold.
